Wholesale operations · internal release 2.1.4

Qashoryx

The problem

Keep invoices, customer balances, cash and stock consistent in offline wholesale workflows.

Engineering decisions

Invoice writes share a transaction with stock and payments. Previous debt stays separate from sales revenue. Staff can invoice existing customers; customer management is owner-only, with checks at controller and service boundaries.

Verification

Windows CI at 627ae9c on 5 October 2026: 162 tests plus 54 subtests; isolated executable build and self-verification succeeded. Earlier reconciliation of 568 invoices, 463 customers and 255 products recorded zero findings.

Release boundaries

Installer, scaling and wider printer/device acceptance remain open. Database and backups are plaintext; session snapshots do not establish immediate revocation.

Python · PySide6 · SQLite · ReportLab · PyInstaller

Offline retail · release candidate

Vendiqo

The problem

Track purchasing, sales and referenced returns without losing the inventory story.

Engineering decisions

An immutable movement ledger supports atomic local operations. Recovery validates archives before mutation, checks the WAL checkpoint, keeps a rollback copy and atomically replaces the live database. Historical customer names survive replay.

Verification

Windows CI at ee93844 on 5 October 2026: 130 tests; Python 3.13 and 3.14 jobs succeeded, including portable build and frozen self-verification.

Release boundaries

Unsigned delivery still needs clean-machine installer, upgrade and hardware acceptance. No roles, authentication or live FBR transmission are claimed.

Python · Qt · SQLite · pytest · Inno Setup

Repair management · first-release build

Fixloom

The problem

Keep intake, repair history and exact PKR payments connected.

Engineering decisions

Seven supported statuses are validated and recorded in job history. Managed photographs and branded job-sheet PDFs accompany ordered database migrations.

Verification

48 tests and eight Alembic migrations recorded in the 1 October review; repository 2d7118a remains unchanged in this review.

Release boundaries

Clean-machine installer acceptance remains pending. Recorded history is not a claim of a tamper-proof audit trail or a directed state machine.

Python · PySide6 · SQLAlchemy · Alembic

Film discovery · private pre-launch build

Cineyra

The problem

Combine longer-term taste and tonight’s preferences into a focused set of recommendations.

Engineering decisions

React and Supabase separate client interaction from server-side integration credentials. Deterministic genre signals drive current matching, with ownership policies and atomic feedback/rating operations.

Verification

21 unit tests recorded in the 1 October review; repository d60e92e remains unchanged. Earlier discovery, recommendation and export checks are recorded separately from release acceptance.

Release boundaries

Account-cache isolation, two-account RLS checks and disposable-account deletion QA remain open. Gemini is disabled pending paid-service opt-in; quota enforcement is best effort.

React · TypeScript · Supabase · PostgreSQL · Edge Functions

Nutrition and fitness · beta foundation

Nourentra

The problem

Structure client assessments and plan review around professional workflows.

Engineering decisions

An eight-step assessment and structured records support a fictional demo workspace. Database guards constrain plan approval; demo flows include notes, measurements, plan edits and revision history.

Verification

9 unit and 26 demo browser tests recorded in the 1 October review; repository c05ca7e remains unchanged.

Release boundaries

Live professional workflows remain unavailable. Live RLS, assessment safety review and replacement of sample dashboards are release gates. Demo evidence does not establish clinical safety.

React · TypeScript · Vite · Supabase

Local budgeting · MVP

Spenvera

The problem

Make income, spending, savings and debts understandable without an account or application server.

Engineering decisions

Native SQLite and web storage use separate adapters. Backups validate envelope metadata, size and nested payloads before replacement. Web restore captures previous values and attempts rollback on failed writes; incomplete rollback is reported.

Verification

45 tests across 19 files recorded on 3 October at 8c71ff2, including corruption and restore-failure paths. Android file-picker access was reported verified on the owner’s phone.

Release boundaries

Wider device and release acceptance remain open. Backups are unencrypted and native/web formats are incompatible. Web rollback is not a transaction; web reminders are disabled.

Expo Router · React Native · TypeScript · SQLite
